brief:
Israel's ambassador to the United Arab Emirates, Yosi Shelley, said Kuwait could join the Abraham Accords within six months, the Ma'an news agency reported. The diplomatic framework, which normalized relations between Israel and several Arab states, has drawn interest from additional Gulf nations seeking to participate.

Shelley's remarks suggest momentum behind expanding the accords' membership, though Kuwait has not formally announced its intention to sign the agreement.
title: Israel's UAE envoy predicts Kuwait may join Abraham Accords within six months
